title: Minimize Maximum Pair Sum in Array
description:
You are given an integer array nums of even length n.

A pair sum is defined as the sum of two elements (a, b), i.e., a + b.

When you form n / 2 pairs using all elements in the array:

Each element must belong to exactly one pair
No element can be reused
Task

Pair up the elements such that the maximum pair sum among all pairs is as small as possible.

Return this minimized maximum pair sum.

Example 1

Input:
nums = [3,5,2,3]

Output:
7

Explanation:
Possible pairing:

(3,3) → sum = 6
(5,2) → sum = 7

Maximum pair sum = max(6, 7) = 7

Example 2

Input:
nums = [3,5,4,2,4,6]

Output:
8

Explanation:
One optimal pairing:

(2,6) → 8
(3,5) → 8
(4,4) → 8

Maximum pair sum = 8

Constraints
n == nums.length
2 ≤ n ≤ 100000
n is even
1 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 100000
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
